objective_contribution: Test whether observable completion readiness improves valid outcomes while reducing or preserving cumulative model tokens.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does one bounded completion-readiness projection after a receipt-confirmed candidate effect and verification observation improve GLM-5.3-flash useful-context completion at 8K while reducing or preserving cumulative tokens?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: Scorer adaptation, full local validation, fresh selection, repositories, scorer smoke, preflight, freeze, live run, score, and decision.

measurement_mapping.native: H65 quality uses the fixed eight-identity denominator; bounded failures produce symmetric arm zeros.
measurement_mapping.retention: One completion-readiness projection is the sole semantic treatment after an exact effect-and-verification boundary.
measurement_mapping.integrity: The effect and later verification activity must each be bound to successful exact-request receipts; the held response has no effects; H63 remains failure-accounting policy.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Known model input plus output usage plus the full admitted input-plus-output reservation for each indeterminate call; never zero-imputed.
measurement_mapping.transfer: The projection uses observable effect, verification, unresolved-state, and evidence records; the transition is domain portable while this run remains GLM code-context evidence.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter before larger windows
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: Continue independent tasks only after a validator-proven bounded local failure; any readiness-boundary, held-effect, ancestry, projection, or unknown-cost violation stops globally.

successor_rule: An H65 pass advances to a larger fresh replication; failure retains H62 or selects a new observation-led hypothesis.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: The rule minimizes and upper-bounds cumulative tokens rather than optimizing latency.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The experiment tests a bounded reasoning-state transition before benchmark replication.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: Round 43 observations select H65 against retained H62 and H0.
